verdict.rationale: Retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for a billing SaaS like Metronome, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no retention settings, deletion APIs, or data-purge controls. Archiving a billable metric keeps it functioning rather than deleting data, and data export to a warehouse is a different capability, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
